name: How much does it cost to widen a doorway for wheelchair access in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to widen a doorway for wheelchair access in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to widen a doorway in the Bay Area varies significantly based on factors like the existing wall structure, materials needed, and labor rates. A non-load-bearing wall might be less expensive than a load-bearing wall, which requires structural modifications and permits. Costs can range from a few hundred dollars for minor adjustments to several thousand for more complex structural changes. It’s best to get a detailed quote after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs to widen a doorway for wheelchair access in the Bay Area depend on wall structure and materials, ranging from hundreds to several thousands of dollars.
